'''Peter Nordstrom Hidden Base DS2 Style''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''Hidden Base DS2 Style'''. [[Peter Nordstrom]] posted it on 16 August 2000.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Peter Nordstrom]]
* '''Published:''' 16 August 2000 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base DS2 Style


== Introduction ==

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

The only problem I found with this deck is that it is kinda slow. The squadron assignments really speeds up deploying, and the Undercover spies stop you from losing to ground drains. The weapons and high destinies in this deck will allow you to rule in space. You can shot the Executor pretty easily with the Admirals Orders, Ten Numb, Intruder Missle. all you need to draw is a 5, and if you shoot at it with another weapon first, you only gotta draw a 2. With the Power Pivot you can make it immediately lost. Use Stay Sharp to shoot your Heavy Turbolaser Batteries during your control phase to knock out a big ship. This deck seems to be able to beat my 2 dark sides, so next I will work on making those better.
